<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>MLC Max Life Capital – Loans, Credit Cards & Insurance</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Mukta:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Noto+Serif+Devanagari:wght@600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#f5f8f2; --surface:#ffffff; --soft:#e8f1e6; --ink:#1d2b24; --muted:#5b6b62;
  --green:#1f7a4d; --green-d:#14573a; --navy:#1b2f4b; --gold:#d9a441; --line:#d9e4d8; --wa:#25d366;
  box-sizing:border-box; padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#101a15;--surface:#172420;--soft:#1d2e27;--ink:#e6efe9;--muted:#9bb0a4;--green:#4fbf86;--green-d:#2f9468;--navy:#9fb8d9;--line:#2a3d34}
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#101a15;--surface:#172420;--soft:#1d2e27;--ink:#e6efe9;--muted:#9bb0a4;--green:#4fbf86;--green-d:#2f9468;--navy:#9fb8d9;--line:#2a3d34}
html{scroll-padding-top:calc(92px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));scroll-behavior:smooth}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:'Mukta',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:17px;line-height:1.6}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Noto Serif Devanagari',Georgia,serif;line-height:1.25;margin:0 0 .5em;color:var(--ink)}
h1{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,5.5vw,3.1rem)} h2{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3.6vw,2.1rem)} h3{font-size:1.15rem}
p{margin:0 0 1em}
a{color:inherit}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
section{padding:64px 0}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}

/* header */
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 92%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;height:84px}
.logo img{display:block;width:min(250px,56vw);height:auto;border-radius:10px;background:#fff}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700}
.mark{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(var(--green) 0 25%,var(--navy) 0 50%,var(--green) 0 75%,var(--navy) 0);display:grid;place-items:center}
.mark i{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg)}
.logo b{display:block;font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.1;color:var(--green-d)}
.logo small{display:block;font-weight:500;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted)}
nav{display:flex;gap:22px}
nav a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}
nav a:hover{color:var(--green)}
.tools{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.lang{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
.lang button{border:0;background:none;padding:6px 12px;font:600 .9rem 'Mukta';color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer}
.lang button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
@media(max-width:760px){nav{display:none}.logo small{display:none}}

/* buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:13px 24px;font:600 1rem 'Mukta';cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .15s,background .15s}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.btn-p{background:var(--green);color:#fff}.btn-p:hover{background:var(--green-d)}
.btn-o{background:transparent;border:2px solid var(--green);color:var(--green)}
.btn-wa{background:var(--wa);color:#073b1b}

/* hero */
.hero{padding:56px 0 48px;background:radial-gradient(900px 400px at 85% 0,color-mix(in srgb,var(--green) 16%,transparent),transparent),radial-gradient(600px 300px at 0 100%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--gold) 14%,transparent),transparent)}
.hero-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:36px;align-items:center}
@media(max-width:820px){.hero-g{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.tag{font-weight:600;color:var(--green-d);background:var(--soft);display:inline-block;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.92rem;margin-bottom:16px}
.hero p.lead{font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:52ch}
.cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:22px}
.offer{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:26px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .offer,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .offer{--x:0}
.offer .chip{background:var(--gold);color:#3a2a05;font-weight:700;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 14px;font-size:.85rem;display:inline-block}
.offer h3{color:#fff;font-size:1.6rem;margin:12px 0 4px}
.offer p{color:#d3deee;margin:0 0 14px}
.offer .btn{background:#fff;color:#1b2f4b}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .offer{background:#22405f}}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .offer{background:#22405f}

/* trust */
.trust{padding:0}
.trust-in{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 26px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px 28px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.trust-in strong{color:var(--green-d)}
.pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.pills span{background:var(--soft);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 14px;font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem}

/* services */
.sec-h{max-width:620px;margin-bottom:30px}
.sec-h p{color:var(--muted)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:18px}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:24px}
.card .ic{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--soft);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:12px}
.card p{color:var(--muted);margin:0;font-size:.98rem}
.band{background:var(--soft)}
.bank-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.bank-list span{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:500;font-size:.95rem}

/* calculator */
.calc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:24px}
@media(max-width:820px){.calc{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.panel{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:26px}
.types{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px}
.types button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;font:600 .95rem 'Mukta';cursor:pointer}
.types button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
.row{margin-bottom:20px}
.row label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}
.row output{color:var(--green-d);font-weight:700}
input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:var(--green)}
.res{background:var(--soft);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;text-align:center}
.emi{font-family:'Noto Serif Devanagari',serif;font-size:clamp(2rem,6vw,2.8rem);color:var(--green-d);font-weight:700;margin:4px 0 16px}
.split{height:12px;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--gold);margin:6px 0 12px}
.split i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--green);transition:width .3s}
.legend{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted);text-align:left}
.legend b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:1.02rem}
.note{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px}

/* form */
.form-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}
@media(max-width:820px){.form-g{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.f{margin-bottom:14px}
.f label{display:block;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px}
.f input,.f select,.f textarea{width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:500 1rem 'Mukta'}
.f textarea{min-height:84px;resize:vertical}
.err{color:#c0392b;font-size:.88rem;display:none;margin-top:3px}
.f.bad .err{display:block}.f.bad input{border-color:#c0392b}
.contact-list{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:18px 0 0}
.contact-list li{margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:600}
.ok{display:none;background:var(--soft);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-top:12px;font-weight:500}

footer{background:var(--navy);color:#cfd9e8;padding:34px 0 90px;font-size:.92rem}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) footer{background:#0b1410}}
:root[data-theme="dark"] footer{background:#0b1410}
footer a{color:#fff}
footer p{margin:0 0 8px}

/* floating */
.fab{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:30;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.fab a{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22);text-decoration:none}
.fab .w{background:var(--wa)}.fab .c{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

/* moving strip */
.strip{padding:18px 0 0}
.marq{overflow:hidden;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 6%,#000 94%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 6%,#000 94%,transparent)}
.track{display:flex;gap:16px;width:max-content;animation:slide 45s linear infinite}
.marq:hover .track{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes slide{to{transform:translateX(calc(-50% - 8px))}}
.mc{width:172px;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;flex:none}
.mc .pic{height:104px}
.mc span{display:block;padding:8px 10px;font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;text-align:center}
.pic{overflow:hidden;border-radius:14px}
.pic svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.card .pic{height:128px;margin-bottom:14px}
.mc .pic{border-radius:0}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.track{animation:none}.marq{overflow-x:auto}}
/* booking */
.visit{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:0 0 26px}
.visit span{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--green-d)}
.book{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px}
@media(max-width:820px){.book{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.calh{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px}
.calh strong{font-size:1.1rem}
.calh button{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-size:1.1rem;cursor:pointer}
.calh button:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
.cal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:4px;text-align:center}
.wd{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;padding:4px 0}
.day{aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:600 .95rem 'Mukta';cursor:pointer}
.day.today{border-color:var(--gold)}
.day:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default;background:none}
.day.sel,.slot.sel,.modes button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--green);color:#fff;border-color:var(--green)}
.slots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(92px,1fr));gap:8px;margin:14px 0}
.slot,.modes button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);border-radius:12px;padding:9px 6px;font:600 .92rem 'Mukta';cursor:pointer}
.slot:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
.modes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px}
.modes button{padding:11px}
.sum{font-weight:600;color:var(--green-d);min-height:1.6em}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="wrap bar">
    <a class="logo" href="#top" aria-label="MLC Max Life Capital – Securing Lives, Empowering Growth"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="MLC Max Life Capital – Securing Lives, Empowering Growth" width="680" height="216"></a>
    <nav>
      <a href="#services" data-en="Services" data-hi="सेवाएँ">Services</a>
      <a href="#calculator" data-en="Loan Calculator" data-hi="लोन कैलकुलेटर">Loan Calculator</a>
      <a href="#book" data-en="Book Visit" data-hi="अपॉइंटमेंट">Book Visit</a>
      <a href="#contact" data-en="Contact" data-hi="संपर्क">Contact</a>
    </nav>
    <div class="tools">
      <div class="lang" role="group" aria-label="Language">
        <button id="b-en" aria-pressed="true">EN</button>
        <button id="b-hi" aria-pressed="false">हिंदी</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="top">
<section class="strip" aria-label="Services"><div class="marq"><div class="track" id="track"></div></div></section>
<section class="hero">
  <div class="wrap hero-g">
    <div>
      <span class="tag" data-en="IRDAI Licensed Insurance Advisor" data-hi="IRDAI लाइसेंस प्राप्त इंश्योरेंस सलाहकार">IRDAI Licensed Insurance Advisor</span>
      <h1 data-en="Loans, credit cards and insurance — one trusted place." data-hi="लोन, क्रेडिट कार्ड और इंश्योरेंस — एक भरोसेमंद ठिकाना।">Loans, credit cards and insurance — one trusted place.</h1>
      <p class="lead" data-en="We help you compare offers from all major banks and NBFCs, and protect your family and business with the right policy." data-hi="हम सभी प्रमुख बैंकों और NBFC के ऑफ़र की तुलना करने में मदद करते हैं और सही पॉलिसी से आपके परिवार व बिज़नेस को सुरक्षित करते हैं।">We help you compare offers from all major banks and NBFCs, and protect your family and business with the right policy.</p>
      <div class="cta">
        <a class="btn btn-p" href="#contact" data-en="Get a free callback" data-hi="फ्री कॉलबैक पाएँ">Get a free callback</a>
        <a class="btn btn-o" href="#calculator" data-en="Calculate my EMI" data-hi="मेरी EMI निकालें">Calculate my EMI</a>
        <a class="btn btn-wa" href="#book" data-en="Book a home visit" data-hi="होम विज़िट बुक करें">Book a home visit</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <aside class="offer">
      <span class="chip" data-en="Special offer" data-hi="खास ऑफ़र">Special offer</span>
      <h3 data-en="Credit cards — Non-CIBIL required" data-hi="क्रेडिट कार्ड — CIBIL ज़रूरी नहीं">Credit cards — Non-CIBIL required</h3>
      <p data-en="No CIBIL score? Ask us about cards you can apply for today. Subject to bank approval." data-hi="CIBIL स्कोर नहीं है? आज ही आवेदन योग्य कार्ड के बारे में पूछें। बैंक की मंज़ूरी के अधीन।">No CIBIL score? Ask us about cards you can apply for today. Subject to bank approval.</p>
      <a class="btn" href="#contact" data-card="1" data-en="Apply for a card" data-hi="कार्ड के लिए आवेदन करें">Apply for a card</a>
    </aside>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="trust">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="trust-in">
      <div><strong data-en="IRDAI certified & licensed with" data-hi="IRDAI प्रमाणित और लाइसेंस प्राप्त">IRDAI certified & licensed with</strong></div>
      <div class="pills"><span>SBI General</span><span>LIC</span><span>Niva Bupa</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="services">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-h">
      <h2 data-en="What we can help you with" data-hi="हम आपकी किस तरह मदद कर सकते हैं">What we can help you with</h2>
      <p data-en="Tell us what you need. We handle the comparison and paperwork guidance." data-hi="बताइए आपको क्या चाहिए। तुलना और कागज़ी कार्यवाही में हम मार्गदर्शन करेंगे।">Tell us what you need. We handle the comparison and paperwork guidance.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="grid">
      <div class="card"><div class="pic" data-img="home"></div><h3 data-en="Home Loan" data-hi="होम लोन">Home Loan</h3><p data-en="Buy, build or transfer your home loan at a competitive rate." data-hi="घर खरीदें, बनवाएँ या होम लोन ट्रांसफर करें — बेहतर दर पर।">Buy, build or transfer your home loan at a competitive rate.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="pic" data-img="personal"></div><h3 data-en="Personal Loan" data-hi="पर्सनल लोन">Personal Loan</h3><p data-en="Quick funds for weddings, travel, medical needs or any plan." data-hi="शादी, यात्रा, इलाज या किसी भी ज़रूरत के लिए तुरंत फंड।">Quick funds for weddings, travel, medical needs or any plan.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="pic" data-img="business"></div><h3 data-en="Business Loan" data-hi="बिज़नेस लोन">Business Loan</h3><p data-en="Working capital and growth funding for shops and companies." data-hi="दुकान और कंपनी के लिए वर्किंग कैपिटल व ग्रोथ फंडिंग।">Working capital and growth funding for shops and companies.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="pic" data-img="car"></div><h3 data-en="Car Loan" data-hi="कार लोन">Car Loan</h3><p data-en="New or used car finance with easy EMIs." data-hi="नई या पुरानी कार के लिए आसान EMI पर फाइनेंस।">New or used car finance with easy EMIs.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="pic" data-img="card"></div><h3 data-en="Credit Cards" data-hi="क्रेडिट कार्ड">Credit Cards</h3><p data-en="Special offer: options available without a CIBIL score." data-hi="खास ऑफ़र: बिना CIBIL स्कोर के भी विकल्प उपलब्ध।">Special offer: options available without a CIBIL score.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="pic" data-img="health"></div><h3 data-en="Health Insurance" data-hi="हेल्थ इंश्योरेंस">Health Insurance</h3><p data-en="Cashless cover for you and your family, including Niva Bupa plans." data-hi="आपके और परिवार के लिए कैशलेस कवर, Niva Bupa प्लान सहित।">Cashless cover for you and your family, including Niva Bupa plans.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="pic" data-img="carins"></div><h3 data-en="Car Insurance" data-hi="कार इंश्योरेंस">Car Insurance</h3><p data-en="New policy or renewal with SBI General and other insurers." data-hi="SBI General व अन्य बीमा कंपनियों के साथ नई पॉलिसी या रिन्यूअल।">New policy or renewal with SBI General and other insurers.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="pic" data-img="life"></div><h3 data-en="Life & Business Insurance" data-hi="लाइफ व बिज़नेस इंश्योरेंस">Life & Business Insurance</h3><p data-en="LIC life plans and cover that protects your shop, stock and staff." data-hi="LIC लाइफ प्लान और दुकान, स्टॉक व स्टाफ को सुरक्षा देने वाला कवर।">LIC life plans and cover that protects your shop, stock and staff.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="band">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-h" style="margin-bottom:0">
      <h2 data-en="Loans from all banks and NBFCs" data-hi="सभी बैंकों और NBFC से लोन">Loans from all banks and NBFCs</h2>
      <p data-en="We are not tied to one lender, so you see more choices before you decide." data-hi="हम किसी एक लेंडर से बंधे नहीं हैं, इसलिए फ़ैसले से पहले आपको ज़्यादा विकल्प मिलते हैं।" style="margin:0">We are not tied to one lender, so you see more choices before you decide.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="bank-list">
      <span data-en="Public sector banks" data-hi="सरकारी बैंक">Public sector banks</span>
      <span data-en="Private banks" data-hi="प्राइवेट बैंक">Private banks</span>
      <span data-en="NBFCs" data-hi="NBFC">NBFCs</span>
      <span data-en="Housing finance companies" data-hi="हाउसिंग फाइनेंस कंपनियाँ">Housing finance companies</span>
      <span data-en="Small finance banks" data-hi="स्मॉल फाइनेंस बैंक">Small finance banks</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="calculator">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-h">
      <h2 data-en="Loan EMI calculator" data-hi="लोन EMI कैलकुलेटर">Loan EMI calculator</h2>
      <p data-en="Move the sliders to see your monthly instalment." data-hi="स्लाइडर चलाकर अपनी मासिक किस्त देखें।">Move the sliders to see your monthly instalment.</p>

<script>
var NUM='919625431452', lang='en';
var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i)};
function setLang(l){
  lang=l; document.documentElement.lang=l==='hi'?'hi':'en';
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-en]').forEach(function(e){e.textContent=e.getAttribute('data-'+l)});
  $('b-en').setAttribute('aria-pressed',l==='en'); $('b-hi').setAttribute('aria-pressed',l==='hi');
  document.title=l==='hi'?'MLC मैक्स लाइफ कैपिटल – लोन, क्रेडिट कार्ड और इंश्योरेंस':'MLC Max Life Capital – Loans, Credit Cards & Insurance';
  try{localStorage.setItem('mlc-lang',l)}catch(e){}
  calc();renderCal();
}
$('b-en').onclick=function(){setLang('en')}; $('b-hi').onclick=function(){setLang('hi')};

function inr(n){return '₹ '+Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
function short(n){
  if(n>=1e7)return '₹ '+(n/1e7).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/,'')+(lang==='hi'?' करोड़':' Cr');
  if(n>=1e5)return '₹ '+(n/1e5).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/,'')+(lang==='hi'?' लाख':' Lakh');
  return inr(n);
}
function calc(){
  var P=+$('amt').value, R=+$('rate').value, Y=+$('yrs').value, n=Y*12, r=R/1200;
  var emi=r===0?P/n:P*r*Math.pow(1+r,n)/(Math.pow(1+r,n)-1);
  var tot=emi*n;
  $('amtO').textContent=short(P); $('rateO').textContent=R.toFixed(1)+'%';
  $('yrsO').textContent=Y+(lang==='hi'?' साल':' yrs');
  $('emi').textContent=inr(emi); $('prin').textContent=inr(P); $('int').textContent=inr(tot-P); $('tot').textContent=inr(tot);
  $('pbar').style.width=(P/tot*100)+'%';
}
['amt','rate','yrs'].forEach(function(i){$(i).addEventListener('input',calc)});
document.querySelectorAll('#types button').forEach(function(b){
  b.onclick=function(){
    document.querySelectorAll('#types button').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false')});
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true'); $('rate').value=b.dataset.r; calc();
  };
});
function pick(v){$('svc').value=v}
$('applyCalc').addEventListener('click',function(){
  var t=document.querySelector('#types button[aria-pressed="true"]').dataset.t;
  pick({home:'Home Loan',personal:'Personal Loan',business:'Business Loan',car:'Car Loan'}[t]);
  $('msg').value='Loan amount: '+inr(+$('amt').value)+', Tenure: '+$('yrs').value+' yrs, Rate: '+$('rate').value+'%, Est. EMI: '+$('emi').textContent;
});
document.querySelector('[data-card]').addEventListener('click',function(){pick('Credit Card (Non-CIBIL)')});

$('send').onclick=function(){
  var nm=$('name').value.trim(), ph=$('phone').value.replace(/\D/g,'');
  var okN=nm.length>1, okP=/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(ph);
  $('fn').classList.toggle('bad',!okN); $('fp').classList.toggle('bad',!okP);
  if(!okN||!okP)return;
  var t='*New enquiry – MLC Max Life Capital*\nName: '+nm+'\nMobile: '+ph+'\nService: '+$('svc').value+'\nCity: '+($('city').value.trim()||'-')+'\nMessage: '+($('msg').value.trim()||'-');
  $('ok').style.display='block';
  window.open('https://wa.me/'+NUM+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(t),'_blank','noopener');
};
$('phone').addEventListener('input',function(){this.value=this.value.replace(/\D/g,'')});

/* illustrations */
var SH='<path d="M60 14 92 26v22c0 18-13 29-32 34C41 77 28 66 28 48V26z" fill="#1f7a4d"/>';
var CAR='<path d="M30 46 40 28h40l12 18z" fill="#4a6fa5"/><path d="M42 44l5-13h12v13zM63 44V31h14l9 13z" fill="#dbe9fb"/><rect x="12" y="44" width="96" height="22" rx="9" fill="#1b2f4b"/><circle cx="36" cy="68" r="10" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="36" cy="68" r="4" fill="#d5d5d5"/><circle cx="84" cy="68" r="10" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="84" cy="68" r="4" fill="#d5d5d5"/>';
var IMG={
home:['#dff0e4','<path d="M18 48 60 14l42 34" fill="none" stroke="#1f7a4d" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><rect x="28" y="48" width="64" height="34" rx="3" fill="#fff"/><rect x="52" y="58" width="16" height="24" rx="2" fill="#d9a441"/><rect x="34" y="54" width="12" height="12" fill="#9fd3b4"/><rect x="74" y="54" width="12" height="12" fill="#9fd3b4"/>'],
personal:['#fbeccb','<circle cx="60" cy="46" r="28" fill="#d9a441"/><circle cx="60" cy="46" r="20" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3"/><text x="60" y="57" text-anchor="middle" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#fff" font-family="sans-serif">₹</text><circle cx="96" cy="68" r="11" fill="#e8c46a"/><circle cx="24" cy="70" r="8" fill="#e8c46a"/>'],
car:['#dce8f7',CAR+'<circle cx="98" cy="22" r="13" fill="#d9a441"/><text x="98" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#fff" font-family="sans-serif">₹</text>'],
business:['#e2efe0','<rect x="24" y="40" width="72" height="42" fill="#fff"/><path d="M18 40 27 20h66l9 20z" fill="#1f7a4d"/><path d="M38 20 34 40M54 20l-2 20M70 20l2 20M86 20l4 20" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3"/><rect x="50" y="54" width="20" height="28" rx="2" fill="#d9a441"/><rect x="30" y="50" width="14" height="14" fill="#9fd3b4"/><rect x="76" y="50" width="14" height="14" fill="#9fd3b4"/>'],
card:['#dfe7f5','<rect x="16" y="20" width="88" height="56" rx="9" fill="#1b2f4b"/><rect x="16" y="33" width="88" height="11" fill="#d9a441"/><rect x="26" y="54" width="22" height="16" rx="3" fill="#e8c46a"/><rect x="60" y="60" width="32" height="5" rx="2" fill="#8fa5c4"/>'],
health:['#fbe0de','<path d="M60 76C30 56 24 36 36 26 46 19 57 25 60 34 63 25 74 19 84 26 96 36 90 56 60 76z" fill="#e5645e"/><path d="M55 36h10v10h10v10H65v10H55V56H45V46h10z" fill="#fff"/>'],
carins:['#dce8f7',CAR+'<g transform="translate(80 4) scale(.42)">'+SH+'<path d="M45 48l11 11 20-22" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g>'],
life:['#dff0e4',SH+'<path d="M45 48l11 11 20-22" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>']
};
function paint(el,k){el.style.background=IMG[k][0];el.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 120 90" aria-hidden="true">'+IMG[k][1]+'</svg>'}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-img]').forEach(function(e){paint(e,e.dataset.img)});
var MQ=[['home','Home Loan','होम लोन'],['personal','Personal Loan','पर्सनल लोन'],['car','Car Loan','कार लोन'],['business','Business Loan','बिज़नेस लोन'],['card','Credit Card','क्रेडिट कार्ड'],['health','Health Insurance','हेल्थ इंश्योरेंस'],['carins','Car Insurance','कार इंश्योरेंस'],['life','Life Insurance','लाइफ इंश्योरेंस']];
var mh='';
for(var rep2=0;rep2<2;rep2++)MQ.forEach(function(m){mh+='<a class="mc" href="#book"'+(rep2?' aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"':'')+'><div class="pic" data-mq="'+m[0]+'"></div><span data-en="'+m[1]+'" data-hi="'+m[2]+'">'+m[1]+'</span></a>'});
$('track').innerHTML=mh;
document.querySelectorAll('[data-mq]').forEach(function(e){paint(e,e.dataset.mq)});

/* booking calendar */
var MO={en:['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'],hi:['जनवरी','फ़रवरी','मार्च','अप्रैल','मई','जून','जुलाई','अगस्त','सितंबर','अक्टूबर','नवंबर','दिसंबर']};
var WK={en:['Su','Mo','Tu','We','Th','Fr','Sa'],hi:['रवि','सोम','मंगल','बुध','गुरु','शुक्र','शनि']};
var SLOTS=['10:00 AM','11:00 AM','12:00 PM','02:00 PM','03:00 PM','04:00 PM','05:00 PM','06:00 PM'];
var mode='home',sd=null,ss=null,vw=new Date();vw.setDate(1);vw.setHours(0,0,0,0);
$('bs').innerHTML=$('svc').innerHTML;
function sod(d){var x=new Date(d);x.setHours(0,0,0,0);return x}
function renderCal(){
  var t=sod(new Date()),mx=new Date(t);mx.setDate(mx.getDate()+60);
  $('calT').textContent=MO[lang][vw.getMonth()]+' '+vw.getFullYear();
  var h=WK[lang].map(function(w){return '<span class="wd">'+w+'</span>'}).join('');
  for(var i=0;i<vw.getDay();i++)h+='<span></span>';
  var dim=new Date(vw.getFullYear(),vw.getMonth()+1,0).getDate();
  for(var d=1;d<=dim;d++){
    var dt=new Date(vw.getFullYear(),vw.getMonth(),d),dis=dt<t||dt>mx;
    h+='<button type="button" class="day'+(sd&&+sd===+dt?' sel':'')+(+dt===+t?' today':'')+'" data-d="'+d+'"'+(dis?' disabled':'')+'>'+d+'</button>';
  }
  $('cal').innerHTML=h;
  var vm=vw.getFullYear()*12+vw.getMonth();
  $('prevM').disabled=vm<=t.getFullYear()*12+t.getMonth();
  $('nextM').disabled=vm>=mx.getFullYear()*12+mx.getMonth();
  renderSlots();
}
function renderSlots(){
  var now=new Date(),h='';
  SLOTS.forEach(function(s){
    var past=false;
    if(sd&&+sd===+sod(now)){past=(parseInt(s,10)%12+(s.indexOf('PM')>0?12:0))<=now.getHours()}
    if(past&&ss===s)ss=null;
    h+='<button type="button" class="slot'+(ss===s?' sel':'')+'" data-s="'+s+'"'+(past?' disabled':'')+'>'+s+'</button>';
  });
  $('slots').innerHTML=h;
  $('sum').textContent=(sd&&ss)?(lang==='hi'?'चुना गया: ':'Selected: ')+sd.toLocaleDateString(lang==='hi'?'hi-IN':'en-IN',{weekday:'short',day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric'})+', '+ss:'';
}
$('cal').onclick=function(e){var b=e.target.closest('.day');if(!b||b.disabled)return;sd=new Date(vw.getFullYear(),vw.getMonth(),+b.dataset.d);renderCal()};
$('slots').onclick=function(e){var b=e.target.closest('.slot');if(!b||b.disabled)return;ss=b.dataset.s;renderSlots()};
$('prevM').onclick=function(){vw.setMonth(vw.getMonth()-1);renderCal()};
$('nextM').onclick=function(){vw.setMonth(vw.getMonth()+1);renderCal()};
document.querySelectorAll('#modes button').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){
  mode=b.dataset.m;document.querySelectorAll('#modes button').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-pressed',x===b)});
  $('fba').style.display=mode==='home'?'':'none';
}});
$('bp').addEventListener('input',function(){this.value=this.value.replace(/\D/g,'')});
$('bookBtn').onclick=function(){
  var nm=$('bn').value.trim(),ph=$('bp').value.replace(/\D/g,''),ad=$('ba').value.trim();
  var a=nm.length>1,b=/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(ph),c=!!(sd&&ss),d=mode!=='home'||ad.length>4;
  $('fbn').classList.toggle('bad',!a);$('fbp').classList.toggle('bad',!b);$('fd').classList.toggle('bad',!c);$('fba').classList.toggle('bad',!d);
  if(!(a&&b&&c&&d))return;
  var ds=sd.toLocaleDateString('en-IN',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
  var t='*Appointment request – MLC Max Life Capital*\nType: '+(mode==='home'?'Home visit':'Phone call')+'\nService: '+$('bs').value+'\nDate: '+ds+'\nTime: '+ss+'\nName: '+nm+'\nMobile: '+ph+(mode==='home'?'\nAddress: '+ad:'');
  $('bok').style.display='block';
  window.open('https://wa.me/'+NUM+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(t),'_blank','noopener');
};

var saved='en'; try{saved=localStorage.getItem('mlc-lang')||'en'}catch(e){}
setLang(saved==='hi'?'hi':'en');
</script>
</body>
</html>
